notes.title: Japanese Version: Font update and Art Book Release!
notes.notes:
☆☆☆
The game font has been updated! 
Please make sure the font "SourceHanSansCN-Light"  is in the "font" folder.

The freem version is also updated and being reviewd, which may take a few days.
Freem: https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/23093


☆☆☆
Art Book is released!
Thanks to our translator Rin!

The book (pdf file "Trick & Treat Art Book JP") will be in your local game folder "EN_Trick & Treat".
It'll be updated to your files if you have already bought the DLC.


Thanks for reading! Have a nice day^^

notes.title: TWTP Update, Hello Charlotte and a New Project!☆
notes.notes:
☆TWTP Update
As planned,  The Witches' Tea Party  will have a v2.0 in June (probabily next week).

In the new version:
+ Lnaguages can be changed in the game.
+ Thai localization added! (Thanks to the hard work of Whateverzone!)
+ A new outfit unlocked for the second run (just like in T&T!)

The game's system has been changed therefore the old save data cannot be used in the new version! Please TURN OFF the Steam auto-update to avoid losing your progress.
There is also a Light version without the steam features on  itch.io , which should have a better performance.
There's no new content in the second run except the outfit [strike]but I hope you can enjoy it anyway[/strike].


☆ Hello Charlotte
I'm honored to have the chance to translate the amazing games of  Hello Charlotte into Chinese! 
The Chinese version of EP2 will be released soon, and EP1 is already for downloading on the  CN blog . 
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29675996/1e586048d0eedad547319e9e90f684d81378495e.jpg


☆ The New Project: Airi's Adventure
The new RPG in development is also going to have a demo soon. The development is basically done yet the translation and testing will still take some time (hopefully in the end of June [strike]though I'm not very confident with my schedule...[/strike]).
It's a very casual (and traditional) turn-based JRPG.
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29675996/f667cef3b5efdacc359ffa251d38f14e96d0cbae.png 
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29675996/85a804597fcd81eb1b573629c790a732cf60b8e6.png
If you're interested please check  the dev blog  for more infomation : )
Or follow on  Twitter  :D

Thanks again for all the support!
